building.name: Arcane Travel Circle
building.description: Approach and right-click this circle to open the travel map. Unlimited travel after construction; unlocks the purchase of small circles.
map.network-hint: Click a circle marker to travel to another built circle
network.current: You are using this circle. Choose a different destination.
network.select-marker: Small circles can travel to other circles. Click a circle marker on the map.
network.sidebar.title: Other-region circles
mini.item.name: Small Travel Circle
mini.item.description: Hold and click an adjacent clear tile to place outdoors, away from the farm. Right-click to use; Ctrl+right-click to pick up. Ten lifetime purchases per save.
mini.requires-main: Build a large circle on the farm before buying or placing a small circle.
mini.invalid-token: This item's purchase license is invalid, or its circle is already placed.
mini.outdoor-only: Small circles can only be placed outdoors, away from the farm.
mini.too-far: Move closer to the tile you want to use.
mini.invalid-placement: Choose an adjacent clear, walkable tile for this circle.
mini.placed: Small circle #{{number}} placed. Right-click to use; Ctrl+right-click to pick up.
mini.inventory-full: Not enough inventory space. An incomplete purchase will be refunded.
mini.picked-up: Small circle #{{number}} picked up. You can place it again for free.
mini.purchase-limit: This save has reached its lifetime limit of ten small-circle purchases.
mini.purchase-failed: The purchase did not finish; no charge was retained. See the SMAPI log.
map.hint: Arcane travel: click a destination on the map
travel.no-safe-tile: There is no safe landing tile near that point. Choose somewhere else.
travel.state-changed: The travel conditions changed. Stand on the circle and reopen the map.
travel.failed: Travel could not be completed. See the SMAPI log for details.
target.outside: Click a location within the world map.
target.unmapped: That point has no reliable outdoor destination.
target.ambiguous: That point could refer to several places. Choose a clearer part of the map.
target.locked: That destination has not been unlocked yet.
target.unsupported: This region is not supported for map travel.
target.unavailable: That destination is not available right now.
target.festival: Travel to that map is unavailable during its special event.
target.indoor: The entrance to that building could not be identified safely.
target.imprecise: This map marker does not contain a selectable outdoor position.
mini.catalogue.name: Small Travel Circle (takeaway)
mini.catalogue.description: 200,000g each; ten lifetime purchases. Requires a built farm gateway. Purchase here to receive one circle in your inventory, then place it outdoors away from the farm.
mini.not-enough-money: Not enough gold: a small circle costs 200,000g.
